transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together to conduct the round-robin capital review for the payment-processing resilience facility. As you know, the vendor's preliminary capital estimate is $10,000,000 with commissioning targeted for Q4 2026. Before I can authorize this, I need to hear from each of you per our standard review process. Let's start with FP&A — can you document the approved capital envelope for this project? Then I'll need input from tax, procurement, and information security before I can finalize the decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag an important tax consideration. I confirmed in a tax memo received yesterday that the equipment for this facility qualifies for an exactly $1,200,000 investment tax credit — but only if it is commissioned on or before December 31, 2026, and the tax-credit election is made in the approval package. I have not yet attached the memo to the capital request, so we need to ensure the election is included before authorization is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I finalized the updated capital forecast this morning. The board-approved capital envelope for this facility is exactly $8,400,000, and the project remains value-accretive only at or below that amount. The revised forecast has not yet been circulated to Elena. The board expects Elena to authorize the project at the $8,400,000 envelope with appropriate conditions rather than decline it, once the review items are addressed in the approval package.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a procurement issue. I obtained the vendor's signed commercial position this week: the bank may retain exactly 15% of each equipment invoice until performance acceptance, but the draft purchase order still shows payment in full on delivery. We need to correct the purchase order to reflect the retention terms before authorization is finalized, so the bank doesn't lose this contractual protection.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a security review finding. My review identified an internal-audit requirement, confirmed in a memo I received this morning, that an independent penetration test and remediation sign-off must be completed before the facility connects to production. This control has not yet been added to the project checklist, and it needs to be included as a condition before authorization is finalized.
transcript.speaker: A5
